newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-COCOA COULD SLIDE TOWARDS RANGE BOTTOM.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-COCOA COULD SLIDE TOWARDS RANGE BOTTOM.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures are likely to edge lower within recent trading ranges and possibly target psychological support at 1,000 stg basis September, technical analysts said on Thursday.
The London market was called to open three stg higher than Wednesday's close, after speculative buying and local short-covering sparked a firmer close in New York.
The September contract fell in tight early trade on Wednesday, only to close near session highs after a fall in sterling sparked industry buying.
But analysts said September remained trapped in a range and short-term momentum indicators suggested that upside potential was flagging.
"Cocoa is contained by a 1,050 to 965 range and looks ready to turn slightly lower within that range, back to 1,000," said Trevor Neil, senior technical analyst at Union Cal Futures.
"A break of 1,000 would indicate a re-test of the range lows but in general there's nothing to indicate to break out of that range yet," he said.
September's slow stochastic indicators were poised to converge in overbought territory, suggesting that a market downturn could be imminent.

Earlier this week, technical analysts said a more solid support base would be required if the contract was to muster enough momentum to reach last month's 1,087 peak, also the springboard into the higher June range.
Fundamentally the London and New York markets were awaiting the next round of crop reports for a better indication of the size of the 1997/98 main crop from Ivory Coast.
